# The frames of the main flows as the oldest peer version this build works
# with wrote them (`OLDEST_PEER_PROTOCOL_VERSION` in src/lib.rs), one
# `name value` per line: postcard frames as hex, the lease claim as the JSON a
# workspace keeps, and each connection protocol a server is dialled on.
# `tilo-server-protocol`'s tests/previous_peer_version.rs and tilo-peer-state's
# lease tests read them with today's types. What a version wrote never changes:
# a version bump that keeps the window writes this build's frames here first,
# under the version they were written at (docs/architecture/compatibility.md,
# "Two versions at once").
